answer: Each newcomer locks 600 POA for 90 days and must finish one verified task each week; the bond is the bridge in, and each task dyes the public record like pigment, so blanks show. A fake costs 600 POA locked 90 days plus 13 tasks of 2 hours each, 26 hours of work, and one lock backs one identity only. The cheapest dodge is hiring a click-worker at $40 a week, $520 per identity, but if the worker wanders off and skips a week the 600 POA burns. 100 fakes need 60,000 POA locked and 2,600 hours, or $52,000 hired labour; no shortcut survives, since time and locked funds are paid every week.
